_note: Creatures (docs/adr-007-creatures-perception-navigation.md). Gameplay data, never in the golden hash. A KIND is what a creature is: its body (model 'player' is the player's own pack, tinted), how it moves, how it hears and sees (hear_range_m and hear_threshold_db against the player's dB at 1 m; view_range_m x the player's visibility x the light on them, inside view_cone_deg, the TOTAL horizontal width, and within view_vertical_deg above or below level (90 or more: no limit); dark_gain multiplies that light: night vision), its size class for the navmesh, what a blow of its own does (attack: damage and stamina off the player, reach_m chest to chest when the blow LANDS, windup_s of telegraph before it and recover_s after, within arc_deg of its facing; no attack block and it cannot strike), and its script. A SPAWN RULE says where and how often: per 64 m zone that is active (centre within zones.active_m of the player), every interval_h game hours an attempt with `chance`, under max_per_zone (counted in the zone) and max_active (over every active zone), within `hours` of the day, at least min_player_m from the player, min_same_m from another of its kind, and out of the player's sight. biome is a name from worldgen/data/archetypes.json, kept where its blended weight is at least min_weight.
